title: Hot Sauces
summary: Explore 75 famous, unusual, and fiercely hot sauces, including pepper oils and chili crisps from around the world.
dataNote: Scoville values distinguish published finished-sauce estimates from featured-pepper ratings. Ingredient heat is not a laboratory result for a diluted sauce or oil, and is compared only with other ingredient ratings. Products without a supportable SHU figure omit that statistic. Listed pepper types count ingredient entries, including disclosed blends; they are not a verified botanical cultivar count. Flavor and rarity grades are Burrow editorial assessments. Locations identify the product or brand home, not necessarily where every ingredient grew.
